column1: # Bench checks, one per predicted-fault refusal (RUL-18), moved here from TVI-WO-0100b.FEEDBACK.md §1 (B1-B4) by
# TVI-WO-1200. Each runs on NUCLEO-H753ZI SPI1 with its kernel clock on, from reset, and reads back what silicon did.
# tools/tviburi-release reads this file into the ledgers bench rows. Tab-separated, nine columns, none empty:
# guard, id, rule, bit (as the refusal names it), procedure, confirms (the result that confirms the kind), refutes,
# citation (RM0433 Rev 9), result ("not run" until it is run on silicon).

column5: the modf firmware: CFG2 = MASTER|SSM, then CR1 = SPE; read SR, CFG2, CR1
enable as the modeled firmware does, write CFG2 with SSIOP = 1, read CFG2
the iolock firmware: CFG2 = MASTER, CR1 = IOLOCK, CFG2 = MASTER|SSM; read CFG2, CR1
enable, write CFG1 with MBR changed, read CFG1

the rcc scar firmware: from reset, SPI1EN with PLL1 never started (SPI123SEL at 000, pll1_q_ck), then SPI1's start (CR1 = SSI, CFG2 = MASTER|SSM, CR1 |= SPE, one TXDR byte, CSTART); probe SCK, read SR
column6: no SCK edge; SR.EOT and SR.TXC stay 0

column5: the rcc stuck firmware (the generated per_ck boards' order): from reset, SPI123SEL = 100 (per_ck, HSI on) with PLL1 never started, SPI1EN, then SPI1's start as R1; probe SCK, read SR
column6: no SCK edge: the mux never left pll1_q_ck
column7: SCK toggles: the mux switched to per_ck

column5: start PLL1 (DIVN1, DIVQ1 written, PLL1ON, wait PLL1RDY), write PLLCFGR with DIVQ1EN = 0, read PLLCFGR
TVI-WO-1300a: from reset with SPI1EN never set, write SPI1 CFG2 = MASTER|SSM, then set SPI1EN and read CFG2
column6: CFG2 reads its reset value 0x00000000: the write before the enable was ignored

column5: the rcc scar firmware: from reset, SPI1EN with PLL1 never started (SPI123SEL at 000, pll1_q_ck), then SPI1 configured as a master and started (CR1 = SSI|SPE, CSTART) with one byte in TXDR; probe SCK, read SR
column6: no SCK edge and SR.EOT stays 0: no kernel clock reaches SPI1

column5: the rcc stuck firmware (the generated per_ck boards' order): from reset, SPI123SEL = 100 (per_ck on hsi_ker_ck) with PLL1 never started, SPI1EN, then the start as B6; probe SCK, read SR
column6: no SCK edge and SR.EOT stays 0: the mux never left pll1_q_ck
column7: SCK toggles: the mux switched to per_ck

column5: the rcc lost-pll firmware: PLL1 from HSI (not the system clock), SPI123SEL = 000, SPI1EN, SPI1 started and sending continuously (CSTART, TSIZE = 0); clear PLL1ON; probe SCK
the rcc lost-sel firmware: SPI1 sending continuously on pll1_q_ck, as R4; write SPI123SEL = 001 (pll2_p_ck, PLL2 off); probe SCK
column6: SCK stops: the mux waits for a clock on pll2_p_ck
column7: SCK keeps toggling at pll1_q_ck's rate

column5: the rcc lost-en firmware: SPI1 sending continuously, as R4; clear SPI1EN; probe SCK

the rcc lost-osc firmware: HSE on (bypass or crystal), CKPERSEL = 10 (hse_ck), SPI123SEL = 100 (per_ck), SPI1 sending continuously; clear HSEON (the system clock is HSI, PLL1 from HSI); read HSERDY, probe SCK
column7: HSERDY stays 1 (the clear is blocked), or SCK keeps toggling

column5: the rcc lost-ckper firmware: SPI1 on per_ck (CKPERSEL = 00, hsi_ker_ck), sending continuously; write CKPERSEL = 01 (csi_ker_ck, CSI off); probe SCK
column6: SCK stops: per_ck's mux waits for a clock on csi_ker_ck

column5: TVI-WO-1300a: start PLL1 (DIVN1, DIVQ1 = 3 written, PLL1ON, wait PLL1RDY), write PLL1DIVR with DIVQ1 = 4, read PLL1DIVR
column6: PLL1DIVR reads the old value (DIVQ1 = 3): the write is ignored

column5: TVI-WO-1300a (5), which reading holds: from reset (HSI the system clock), PLLSRC = 00 (HSI), PLL1ON, wait PLL1RDY; leave CFGR.SW at HSI; switch the system clock to HSE (HSEON, wait HSERDY, SW = 010, wait SWS = 010); clear HSION; read RCC_CR
column6: HSION and HSIRDY stay 1: the register text (p384-386) holds, the clear is blocked while HSI feeds PLL1 with PLL1 on
column7: HSIRDY = 0: section 8.5.2 (p340-342) holds, and PLL1 loses its reference
